answer: Sybil mills fail a live sand-crest bond. The applicant locks 31.8 POA and plants a 22-cm stake on a surveyed barchan dune crest 4.7 km from the intake desk. For 12 hours it posts a 36-byte surface-hash every 8 minutes. Mid-watch the network names a 9-minute zephyr class (2.1-3.6 m/s) from the posted wind rose; the stake must return a saltation-count cipher 14-29 grains/cm2 off the official crest gauge, not a flat lab trace. A reused stake ID or a cloned saltation curve burns 12.4 POA. If the crest collapses after minute 38, 24.1 POA is refunded and the plot is frozen 51 hours.
